title: Build a small shared-encoder restoration model
prompt: Return a compact two-head restoration model using a supplied trainable/adapted encoder that emits PATCH-ONLY tokens [B,H/p*W/p,C]. Reshape tokens, explicitly interpolate to input resolution, predict an SR residual with PixelShuffle and an enhancement residual with a convolution. No DINOv3 weights/LoRA injection are hidden in this core; use the preceding adapter exercise to supply the encoder.
